purpose: Separate repository activity from publication. Vercel remains connected infrastructure, but deployment is an explicitly authorized side effect.
non_deploying_changes: ordinary source commits unless explicitly authorized for release
bypass_prohibition: No GitHub workflow, repository event, commit, branch push, pull request, note, document, or automation may invoke Vercel deployment outside the release authorization contract.
truth_rule: CONNECTED != DEPLOYABLE; COMMITTED != RELEASED; VERIFIED != PRODUCTION_PROVEN; AUTHORIZED != SUCCESSFUL UNTIL DEPLOYMENT EVIDENCE EXISTS.
